case_id_reuse_hazard.rule: P06 case ids are NOT stable across benchmark versions. v1.2 renumbers routes per (submission, construct), so a v1.1 case id can denote a different property in v1.2. Never join v1.1 and v1.2 P06 evidence on case_id; join on property_id and compare envelope hashes.
